{{Top|leg}}
'''Consulates''' were government buildings that acted as an embassy for a foreign group on a planet.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], spacers when making trips were required each time to indicate the location of the nearest Consulate of their home planets via regulation star coordinates.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], when trying to find the [[Cantham House/Legends|Alderaanian Consulate]] for the [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|second Wedding attempt]] between [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], went to the [[Aldereenian Consulate]] by mistake.
